name: Stretched Sinograms for Neural Tomographic Reconstruction
definition: A direct reconstruction method for limited-angle electron tomography that preprocesses tilt views by stretching them perpendicular to the tilt axis by a factor of sec(θ), then feeds the stretched views into a 2-D U-Net to directly output a 3-D reconstruction, avoiding backprojection.
summary: Stretched Sinograms is a direct reconstruction method for limited-angle electron tomography that preprocesses tilt views by stretching them to compensate for the missing wedge before feeding them into a 2-D U-Net.
